note: Small William A. Switzer PP campground of open sites for RVs and tents, 19 km north of Hwy 16 on Hwy 40 then a few km SE on a gravel access road, with a hand launch; Graveyard Lake and Cache Lake are a short walk away on interpretive trails. Firewood is sold at the Switzer Park Visitor Centre and the Gregg Lake booth; sani-dump at Gregg Lake (fee). --Claude

The old note's '10 walk-in tent sites', 'cook shelter', 'group fire pits', 'beach and dock' are not on the page (its table lists no walk-in type, unlike Wildhorse's, and its amenities are Firepits, Pit/Vault Toilets, Hand Launch, Water - Pump); dropped from the note.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront): KEEP not waterfront; lead for creekside. The page (text shared with Halfway) says 'Many sites back directly on to Jarvis Creek.' Esri imagery Sep 22, 2023: one open grass/gravel clearing (~60 x 80 m) with a small loop; Jarvis Creek (~8-10 m wide, so creekside not riverfront) meanders past its west and south edges ~10-20 m away through shrubs and a few spruce. No site map exists (the shop placeholders carry no GIS), so no sites can be numbered. Recommend not waterfront; a site map or photos placing pads on the open bank would support creekside. The stored evidence is wrong on two points: its coordinate 53.4945,-117.9850 is a longitude typo (the camp is at -117.7985), and Graveyard Lake is ~250 m west, not reached by any walk-in sites the page knows of.
